decision_summary.clipboard: System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard write-only on STA UI thread
decision_summary.firefox_adapter: Firefox Manifest V3 WebExtension, plain JavaScript, no content scripts
decision_summary.firefox_native_bridge: runtime.connectNative persistent Port to same installed helper executable in native-host proxy mode
decision_summary.custom_browser_candidate: .NET 10 WinForms + Evergreen WebView2, conditional spike only
decision_summary.packaging: per-user self-contained win-x64 single-file helper + signed unlisted Firefox XPI + deterministic install/uninstall PowerShell
decision_summary.auto_update: none in v0; explicit reviewed release update
decision_summary.custom_shell_adoption: only after normal authentication succeeds without workaround and UX-09/UX-10 measurements materially beat baseline

notes: Active LTS through 2028.
Direct WinForms tray/clipboard support and Win32 RegisterHotKey P/Invoke.
Self-contained single-file win-x64 publish supported.
Named pipes support CurrentUserOnly, including Windows account and elevation-level checks.
Best likely idle footprint/startup ceiling.
More Windows/UI plumbing and crate-selection burden for tray/clipboard/native messaging.
No measured need yet justifies the implementation complexity.
Repository already contains substantial Python, but the operator helper is a Windows appliance rather than core orchestration code.
Reliable native-messaging launch and tray/hotkey packaging require interpreter/bundler and third-party packages.
Higher dependency/runtime variance than the selected .NET path.
Small adapter surface does not require a compiler/bundler.
Use JSON Schema contracts plus JSDoc for message shapes.
Firefox MV3 uses background.scripts/event page; Firefox does not support extension background service_worker.
Useful if extension grows materially.
Adds build/pinning/supply-chain surface before justified by code size.
Required APIs are supported without host permissions or content scripts.
Signed extension deployment path is documented.
Normal browser authentication path is preserved.
Evergreen runtime provides automatic browser-engine security updates.
Shared CoreWebView2Environment/user-data folder can reduce duplicated processes/memory.
Embedded OAuth providers can reject embedded user-agents; manual ChatGPT sign-in feasibility must be proven without cookie/token transfer or bypass.
Adds bundled Chromium/runtime update responsibility or larger dependency surface.
No advantage to test before WebView2 proves the custom-shell concept.

evidence.finding: .NET 10 is active LTS through November 2028; selected instead of .NET 11 RC.
RegisterHotKey defines a system-wide hotkey and WM_HOTKEY delivery.
WinForms NotifyIcon is available on Windows Desktop .NET 10.
PipeOptions.CurrentUserOnly restricts pipe peers to the same user; on Windows it also verifies elevation level.
Firefox Native Messaging uses JSON over stdin/stdout, requires nativeMessaging, and exact allowed_extensions may be enforced by the host manifest.
Firefox MV3 does not support extension background service_worker and uses background.scripts/event page.
Signed MV3 Firefox extensions require an explicit ID; current AMO submissions also require data_collection_permissions declaration.
tabs permission permits URL metadata access without host permissions; content access still requires other APIs/permissions.
sessions tab values provide extension-only non-authoritative binding metadata.
inactive tabs can be discarded and later restored; active tabs cannot be discarded.
Release/Beta Firefox add-ons require Mozilla signing; unlisted self-distribution is supported.
Microsoft recommends Evergreen WebView2 and sharing one CoreWebView2Environment for memory efficiency.
Google OAuth may return disallowed_useragent when authorization is shown in an embedded user-agent.
Current individual-service terms prohibit automatic/programmatic extraction of data or Output and circumvention of restrictions/protective measures; UX-08 boundary remains mandatory.
